rule: every row of data/check-catalogue.tsv whose probe is not core has no file of that check in src/checks/
notes: The code of a check lives in the package of the feature that registers it (F112-FR-033). The doctor holds the registry, the runner, the renderers and the checks whose probe the catalogue marks core.

A catalogue row whose probe another package supplies keeps its id, severity rule, flag, message and fix as data of this feature; the probe lives in the package that supplies it, and no file of that check is held in src/checks/.

An owner registers through the registration call of the kernel package (registerDoctorCheck, F100-FR-234, annex G §G.7), so it does not import the doctor, and the doctor does not import the package of an owner.
